title: Iteration 0: Project Foundation
body:
## Goal
Bootstrap `learnmap/app` (frontend) and `learnmap/api` (backend) repositories as defined in the system architecture, with local Docker Postgres, Prisma schema, and CI so feature work can start.

## Scope
**In scope**
- Create and scaffold `learnmap/api` (NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL)
- Create and scaffold `learnmap/app` (React + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + React Router + TanStack Query)
- Docker Compose for local PostgreSQL
- Initial Prisma schema matching `architecture/data-model.md`
- CI lint/build pipelines for both repos

**Out of scope**
- Feature implementation (auth, catalog, viewer, etc.)
- Production deployment / hosting

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `learnmap/api` and `learnmap/app` repos exist and build cleanly
- [ ] Local Postgres runs via Docker Compose
- [ ] Prisma schema matches the approved data model and migrates successfully
- [ ] CI runs lint + build on both repos

## Backlog
- **Status:** Backlog
- **Type:** epic
- **Priority:** P0

## Feature Breakdown
See child tasks linked after creation.

## Repos Involved
- learnmap/api
- learnmap/app
- learnmap-cursor/specs (tracking)

## References
- [System Overview](https://github.com/learnmap-cursor/specs/blob/main/architecture/system-overview.md)
- [Frontend Architecture](https://github.com/learnmap-cursor/specs/blob/main/architecture/frontend.md)
- [Data Model](https://github.com/learnmap-cursor/specs/blob/main/architecture/data-model.md)

title: [API] JWT httpOnly cookie — sign, verify, auth guard
body:
## Description

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] JWT is set as httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure (in prod) cookie
- [ ] JwtAuthGuard returns 401 for missing or invalid tokens
- [ ] POST /api/auth/logout clears the cookie
- [ ] Expired tokens return 401 and are not silently accepted

title: [API] Roadmap CRUD — create, update, delete, publish, unpublish
body:
## Description
Implement the core roadmap lifecycle endpoints: create (draft), update metadata, publish, unpublish, and delete. Owner guard enforced on all mutating endpoints.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] POST /api/roadmaps creates a draft roadmap owned by the calling user
- [ ] PATCH /api/roadmaps/:id updates title, description, tags (owner only)
- [ ] POST /api/roadmaps/:id/publish sets isPublished=true; roadmap appears in catalog
- [ ] POST /api/roadmaps/:id/unpublish sets isPublished=false; removed from catalog, enrolled users unaffected
- [ ] DELETE /api/roadmaps/:id removes roadmap and all topics, edges, enrolments, and progress (owner only, confirmation required at API level via separate endpoint or header)



## Backlog
- **Status:** Backlog
- **Type:** feature
- **Priority:** P2

{{PARENT}}

## Description
Implement endpoints for managing the structure of a roadmap: add/update/delete topic nodes, create/delete edges, and manage optional sections.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] POST /api/roadmaps/:id/topics creates a topic (or sub-topic via parentId)
- [ ] PATCH /api/topics/:id updates title, description, position (owner only)
- [ ] DELETE /api/topics/:id removes the topic, its edges, and its progress records
- [ ] POST /api/roadmaps/:id/edges creates a directional edge between two topics
- [ ] DELETE /api/edges/:id removes an edge
